comment: Recognition layer 2: community/district signs. Shown as a highway-style green sign + HUD when the car enters each community. Coordinates are real lat/lon projected into world space at runtime (same pipeline as landmarks.json). radius = trigger distance in compressed-world meters. Entries flagged needs_owner_review: true have coordinates from map data — owner's lived knowledge is authoritative.

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: The narrow strip of land between the airport and Kingston — sea on both sides

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Roundabout gateway from the Palisadoes into Kingston proper

communities.name: Rock Fort
communities.note: East Kingston community by the 17th-century fort ruins along Windward Road

communities.name: Wareika Hill
communities.note: Hillside community above East Kingston — confirm visibility from Mountain View Ave

communities.name: Kingston
communities.note: Capital city — broad city-limit sign on the main road in

communities.name: Cross Roads
communities.note: The classic Kingston junction — a mandatory shout-out

communities.name: New Kingston
communities.note: The financial and hotel district — uptown Kingston

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: Major uptown commercial hub — the 1813 clock tower marks the centre

communities.name: Whitfield Town
communities.note: West Kingston community along the Spanish Town Road corridor

communities.name: Caymanas
communities.note: Home of Caymanas Park racecourse — Jamaica's main horse racing venue

communities.name: Angels
communities.note: Small community on the approach to the Bog Walk gorge

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Gateway to the gorge — Flat Bridge crossing of the Rio Cobre nearby

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: Market town immortalised in 'Linstead Market' — famous for ackee and saltfish

communities.name: Ewarton
communities.note: Industrial town on the Linstead–Moneague stretch near the bauxite works

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Hilltop village — junction of the inland route north toward Ocho Rios

communities.name: Mount Rosser
communities.note: Steep hillside between Moneague and Faith's Pen — the off-road danger zone per GAME_SPEC

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: Famous roadside cookshop strip — jerk chicken, roast yam, festival. Must-stop.

communities.name: Claremont
communities.note: Small St. Ann town on the descent toward Fern Gully

communities.name: Alexandria
communities.note: Community just north of Claremont before the Fern Gully approach

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: 3 km of dense tree canopy over the road — one of Jamaica's most scenic stretches

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: Tourist hub on the north coast — Dunn's River Falls is just ahead
